title: 第1037章 贾昂的挣扎第1036章 胡海的判断
slug: 穿成皇子六连抽建立万古帝朝
lines: 柳文说道：“你心中有数就好，你现在有什么困难吗？”
贾昂说道：“暂时没有，怎么了？是有什么事情？”
柳文说道：“倒是也没有什么，只是想问问你，你对胡海的看法。”
贾昂一愣，说道：“胡海？我倒是没有什么其他的看法，他能力确实挺强，要不然我也不会那么信任他，
而他在我手下藏了这么久，我也没有发现，这个人，有自己的想法，而且对于很多事情，
他能很快地执行，并且能让所有人放心。”
柳文说道：“你对他的评价好像很高啊。”
贾昂说道：“我只是陈述客观的事实，并没有什么其他的想法。”
柳文说道：“那我现在说一下，之后这边的事情，还需要你来处理，你暂时就不用先回去了，等之后，
我们会通知你回去。”
贾昂说道：“好，这倒是没有什么，对我来说，在哪里都一样。”
柳文说道：“最近不太平，所以你还是要小心，赤伶会的人，不会那么轻易放弃这个机会，
现在冥庭帝朝还有很多的事情，如果张珍铭在之前，安排了人，我想，不止是魔神组织的人，
赤伶会的人，也会知晓，张珍铭那个人，后手很多，你自己要小心，你发现的那些，可能是他们想让你发现的，
而不是真的你能发现的人，他们暗处的人，还是很多的。”
贾昂点了点头，说道：“这个我明白，我会好好注意的，倒是有件事，需要老祖商议一下，
就是之前和我在圆桌会的人，能不能让他们也过来帮我，要不然我这里可能会有很多事情，
有可能精力达不到。”
柳文说道：“这个没有什么问题，我回去之后，就让他们来，不用担心。”
贾昂点了点头，随后柳文便离开了。
很快邢军和芦斌便来了，芦斌说道：“你倒是挑了一个好时机，让我们两个来了。”
贾昂说道：“这个时间不是刚刚好吗？你们来了，我也能省点心，同时，还能解决你的问题。”
邢军说道：“最近发生的事情，太多了，很多事情，都不是我们想要的结果，
但是大家还是要接受这件事，有些太怪了。”
贾昂说道：“有什么怪的，不过还是之前的逻辑？弱肉强食，三人小组，比安排和薛英柏他们强，
他们就只能受着，就和我们打不过他们两个一样，一直都是这个逻辑，没有什么奇怪的。”
邢军说道：“倒也是，只是我们实力不行，不过他们把你弄进来常青阁，倒是件好事。”
贾昂说道：“有什么好的，不过就是让我成为常青阁里面那个干活的，而且是个听话干活的而已，
要不然那个常青阁做了决定，你们指望谁去做？不还是我们？说的好听，不过就是想要制衡我们而已，
安亮他们，也是一样，不想认，但是他们又没有任何办法，你看向现在安亮和薛英柏两个人，
content_en:
Liu Wen said: "As long as you have an idea, do you have any difficulties now?"
Jia Ang said: "Not yet, what's wrong? What's going on?"
Liu Wen said: "It's nothing, I just want to ask you what you think of Hu Hai."
Jia Ang was stunned and said: "Hu Hai? I don't have any other opinions. He is indeed very capable. Otherwise, I wouldn't trust him so much.
And he has been hiding under my hand for so long, and I have not discovered that this person has his own ideas, and about many things,
He executes quickly and puts everyone at ease. "
Liu Wen said: "You seem to have a high opinion of him."
Ja Ang said: "I am just stating objective facts and have no other ideas."
Liu Wen said: "Then let me tell you now that you will still need to handle the matters here in the future. You don't need to go back for the time being. Later,
We will notify you to return. "
Jia Ang said: "Okay, it's nothing. To me, it's the same everywhere."
Liu Wen said: "It's not peaceful recently, so you still have to be careful. People from the Chi Ling Society will not give up this opportunity so easily.
There are still many things going on in the Mingting Emperor. If Zhang Zhenming had arranged for people before, I think it would be more than just people from the Demon God Organization.
People in the Chi Ling Society will also know that Zhang Zhenming has a lot of tricks up his sleeve. You have to be careful. What you discover may be what they want you to discover.
Rather than the people you can actually discover, there are still many people in the dark. "
Jia Ang nodded and said: "I understand this, and I will pay close attention to it. However, there is something I need to discuss with my ancestors.
The people who were at the round table with me before, can you ask them to come over and help me? Otherwise, I might have a lot of things here.
It is possible that the energy is not enough. "
Liu Wen said: "There is no problem with this. I will let them come after I go back. Don't worry."
Jia Ang nodded, and then Liu Wen left.
Soon Xing Jun and Lu Bin came. Lu Bin said, "You picked a good time to let the two of us come."
Jia Ang said: "Isn't this the right time? If you come, I can save some worries and at the same time, I can solve your problem."
Xing Jun said: "Too many things have happened recently, and many of them are not the results we want.
But everyone still has to accept this, it’s a little too weird. "
Jia Ang said: "What's weird, but it's still the same logic as before? The jungle of the jungle, a three-person team, is better than Arrangement and Xue Yingbai.
They can only accept it, just like we can't defeat them two. This has always been the logic, there is nothing strange about it. "
Xing Jun said: "That's true, it's just that we are not strong enough, but it is a good thing that they brought you into Changqing Pavilion."
Jia Ang said: "What's good is that it just makes me the one who works in Changqing Pavilion, and I am an obedient worker.
Otherwise, if Chang Qing Pavilion makes a decision, who do you expect to make it? Or us? It sounds nice, but he just wants to check and balance us.
An Liang and the others are the same, they don't want to admit it, but they have no choice. You look at An Liang and Xue Yingbai now,
